notices.text: No cell-footprint comb measured on the raw D-frame accumulation grid, before any display smoothing (occupancy lag-1 +0.51, energy lag-1 +0.49 on the brightest row and +0.38 on the column sums).

Bins below 10⁻³ of ρ_ref are not drawn (X′Y′ 323 bins holding 0.159% of its in-window energy; Y′Z′ 606 bins holding 0.363% of its in-window energy; X′Z′ 731 bins holding 0.422% of its in-window energy), so the outer edge of the colour is the display floor, not the edge of the shower. Bins with no energy at all are empty.
With 2 co-registered event(s) the fitted display ranges rest on weak evidence and are labelled provisional.

Colours are relative to this selection's own peak density on the raw 20 mm accumulation grid (stated in the panel's Details drawer), which the displayed field never exceeds; switch the density normalisation to the dataset peak to compare colours across selections.
Shower A: transverse direction resultant R̄′ = 0.867, Rayleigh p = 0.222 over N = 2 — not distinguishable from uniform.
Shower B: transverse direction resultant R̄′ = 0.905, Rayleigh p = 0.194 over N = 2 — not distinguishable from uniform.

Anchor: the back-projected 3-D centroid (anchor=backprojected). The other definition, the first-layer entry point P0, lands a transverse distance away at the front face of shower A median 178 mm, p90 281 mm, 2 over one cell footprint; shower B median 180 mm, p90 309 mm, 1 over one cell footprint (N = 2).

centroid_dataset.label: Dataset centroids (absolute-frame per-event average; not drawn in the D-frame - see centroids.canonical_mean)

coherence.note: Absolute-frame azimuth is near-uniform (resultant length above), which is why no averaged direction is drawn there. In the D-frame the directions are co-registered first; the dashed lines are the two ensemble axes, each with its transverse resultant R̄′ and Rayleigh p stated.

pointing.note: Incident directions point at the detector origin: against the radial line through each shower's 3-D centroid the residual is A: −1.5° ± 0.3° SD over N = 2 (1 d.o.f., weak), r / tan θ = 3,977 mm against a centroid depth of 3,970 mm; B: +0.9° ± 0.3° SD over N = 2 (1 d.o.f., weak), r / tan θ = 3,997 mm against a centroid depth of 4,006 mm. The azimuth is uniform over the face only because the entry points are, so the showers entering one window share a direction: zoom a depth panel and the ensemble axis of the events entering its window is drawn.

slab.note: The X′Y′ panel sums the entrance slab: the first 6 sampling layers, 120 mm from the front face at z′ = 0.

frame.anchor_note: Each shower's 3-D centroid is back-projected to the front face along its incident direction; the midpoint of the two entry points is the origin and the A→B entry separation is the +x′ axis, which the entry (X′Y′) panel writes as D: the signed coordinate along the separation, with the anchors at D = ∓⟨D_entry⟩/2 and tick values in mm. D_entry is the transverse entry separation; D (the slider) is the absolute-frame 3-D centroid distance from the dataset.

anchor_residual.definition: transverse distance at the front face between the back-projected 3-D centroid and the back-projected first-layer entry point P0, per shower

fit.note: Display windows are symmetric about the origin along x′ and y′, each half-width covering the 0.1st to 99.9th energy percentile, never below 200 mm (a provisional one-shower floor), and snapped outward to whole 20 mm bins. Drawn x′ bins beyond the window are counted and marked at its edge, not drawn (X′Z′ 1 bin(s), −2,120 to −2,100 mm, 0.009% of the panel's energy): islands too small to set the window, or bins the percentile rule already cut. Up to 0.021% of a panel's energy lies outside its window on the raw accumulation grid; it is excluded from the view but not from the statistics. Depth is never cropped. With 2 co-registered event(s) the fitted ranges are provisional.

comb.note: No cell-footprint comb measured on the raw D-frame accumulation grid, before any display smoothing (occupancy lag-1 +0.51, energy lag-1 +0.49 on the brightest row and +0.38 on the column sums).
comb.measured_on: raw accumulation grid, before display smoothing

rho.basis: peak of the raw 20 mm accumulation grid of this selection, before display reconstruction

reconstruction.label: none (raw bins)
reconstruction.depth: native sampling layers, never smoothed or interpolated
reconstruction.note: Native Grid: the raw 20 mm accumulation bins with no reconstruction, the audit view. Total transverse blur including the 6 × 6 footprint splat and the 20 mm binning: 16.0 mm RMS in x′, 16.1 mm in y′.

notes: Shower A: transverse direction resultant R̄′ = 0.867, Rayleigh p = 0.222 over N = 2 — not distinguishable from uniform.
Shower B: transverse direction resultant R̄′ = 0.905, Rayleigh p = 0.194 over N = 2 — not distinguishable from uniform.

depth_layers.note: Detector layers, numbered by lattice ordinal 1–56: the D-frame's depth z′ = z − 3662.4 mm is one shift for every event, so its layers are the detector's own and its seams the lattice's stored cell edges, shifted. The lattice skips layers the file never populates, so an ordinal is the lattice's own count, not a physical layer slot.
